articles.title: BoxBoy + BoxGirl rated in Taiwan for Nintendo Switch 2
articles.summary: A new game, 'BoxBoy + BoxGirl' from Hal Labs, has been rated by the Taiwan Rating Board for the unannounced Nintendo Switch 2 console. This rating surfaced prior to any official announcement, adding to a series of leaks concerning the next-generation Nintendo hardware. It provides unofficial confirmation of an upcoming title for the highly anticipated, yet unrevealed, console.

articles.title: AI Conversation With R2-D2, Skynet, HAL 9000, 'M3gan,' Samantha of 'Her'
articles.summary: The Hollywood Reporter recently orchestrated a unique discussion involving five iconic fictional AI systems from popular films. These simulated intelligences engaged in a fascinating debate about the current state and future trajectory of artificial intelligence, their profound impact on humanity, and even their own potential aspirations. This thought experiment offers valuable insights into the complex ethical and societal implications surrounding advanced AI.

articles.title: India-Russia BrahMos venture posts record revenue
articles.summary: Indo-Russian BrahMos Aerospace achieved record 2025-26 revenue with 48.6% growth, showcasing India's burgeoning defence manufacturing capabilities. Vietnam is considering a significant $611.5 million deal for BrahMos supersonic missiles, marking India's successful expansion into global defense exports. This strengthens India's strategic position and economic influence in the international arms market, vital for national security.

articles.title: Eyes on the next global flashpoint: Why India is pouring billions into a remote island
articles.summary: Greater Nicobar, India's southernmost and largest island, possesses immense strategic importance due to its dominance over the Malacca Strait, a critical maritime chokepoint handling 60% of global trade. Developing its infrastructure and military presence here would significantly enhance India's maritime security, surveillance capabilities over vital shipping lanes, and regional influence, crucial for national defence and economic interests.

articles.title: President Murmu exhorts Army Training Command to enhance Army's operational preparedness
articles.summary: President Droupadi Murmu exhorted the Army Training Command (ARTRAC) in Shimla to relentlessly enhance the Indian Army's operational preparedness. She underscored ARTRAC's pivotal role in shaping future military leaders and ensuring forces remain agile and capable of meeting evolving security challenges. This directive emphasizes the continuous need for robust training and strategic readiness, crucial for national defence.

articles.title: Australia, Malaysia reinforce regional security
articles.summary: HMAS Warramunga of Australia and KD Lekir from Malaysia have successfully concluded the Malaysia-Australia Training Exercise (MASTEX) off Australia's west coast. This iteration underscores the continuous defence cooperation and interoperability between their navies. Such joint exercises are vital for enhancing strategic partnerships, strengthening regional security, and improving naval capabilities within the Indo-Pacific.

articles.title: 15 Movies That Captured the Cold War Paranoia of the ’70s and ’80s
articles.summary: This film, released post-1980s, effectively embodies Cold War tensions, focusing on crucial themes like submarine warfare and pervasive political uncertainty. It delves into the era's deep mistrust and instances of defection. For SSB aspirants, it offers insights into the strategic military and geopolitical challenges that defined superpower rivalry during this critical historical period.

articles.title: Ukraine begins to flex muscle as an emerging air power, angering Russia
articles.summary: Ukraine has significantly escalated its strikes on Russian territory, deploying advanced technology to hit oil storage, ports, and refineries up to 1,600 km deep into the Urals. This demonstrates Ukraine's expanding long-range strike capabilities and strategic intent to disrupt Russia's war economy. Such precision targeting of critical infrastructure impacts the ongoing conflict.

articles.title: India eyeing partnership for 6th-gen fighter aircraft, to issue AMCA RFP soon: Defence secy; We’re ready for Agni 6, awaits Centre's nod: DRDO Chief
articles.summary: India's Defence Secretary announced the imminent issuance of an AMCA RFP, seeking partnerships for a 6th-generation fighter, underscoring indigenous airpower goals. Concurrently, the DRDO Chief confirmed readiness for the strategic Agni-6 missile, awaiting government approval. These developments highlight India's commitment to modernizing its military, enhancing advanced defence capabilities, and strengthening strategic deterrence for national security.
